title: Blast Radius
description: What a hijacked agent key costs under three custody models: a raw EOA key loses the whole wallet instantly, an expiry-only session key does too, and a per-period spend permission caps the bleed. Drag the sliders — or load a real 35.97 USDC/day permission pulled off Base — and watch the staircase.
controls: drag sliders to shape the permission and detection time
press ⬢ real base permission to load the on-chain example
